headline: Sical Logistics wins Rs 39.23 Cr order from SAIL
summary: Sical Logistics secures Rs 39.23 Cr work order from SAIL for iron ore excavation. Order book coverage stands at 4.04 quarters, with recent inflows totaling Rs 534.73 Cr.

headline: Mishka Exim appoints Rakesh Aggarwal as Independent Director
summary: Mishka Exim Limited has appointed Rakesh Aggarwal as Non-Executive Independent Director for a five-year term, effective July 27, 2026, following AGM approval.

headline: Virtuoso Optoelectronics signs MOU with Maharashtra
summary: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited signed a non-binding MOU with the Government of Maharashtra for a proposed investment of ₹1,050 crore over five years.

headline: CESTAT upholds ₹2,751 lakh refund for Sun Pharma Advanced Research
summary: The Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal confirmed Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company's entitlement to a refund of accumulated CENVAT credit worth ₹2,751 lakh.

headline: SGL Resources AGM: All 8 resolutions passed
summary: SGL Resources Ltd passed all 8 resolutions at its 34th AGM held on September 30, 2026. Key approvals included financial statements, director appointments, and enhanced borrowing limits.

headline: Yes Bank Q2FY27 provisional business update
summary: Yes Bank disclosed provisional Q2FY27 business metrics as on September 30, 2026, showing loans at INR 309,675 crore (up 23.8% YoY) and deposits at INR 354,084 crore (up 19.5% YoY).

headline: NHC Foods subsidiary signs LOI for Singapore acquisition
summary: Conquer Enterprises, a foreign step-down subsidiary of NHC Foods, signed a non-binding LOI to acquire 75% equity in DNR Ventures Pte Ltd for $5.5 million.

headline: ASM Technologies EGM approves preferential issue
summary: ASM Technologies held an Extra Ordinary General Meeting on October 4, 2026, to approve a preferential allotment of securities and the appointment of a new independent director.

headline: Ravinder Heights director resigns
summary: Ravinder Heights Limited announced the resignation of Raghava Lakshmi Narasimhan as Non-Executive and Independent Director, effective October 3, 2026, citing age and health reasons.

headline: Anup Engineering gets GST demand set aside
summary: The Appellate Authority allowed Anup Engineering's appeal, setting aside a ₹3.32 crore GST demand. The company confirms no impact on financials.

headline: DLF sells out Aureva luxury project for ₹1,985 crore
summary: DLF Limited announced the complete sell-out of The Aureva, a luxury retirement housing project in Gurugram, achieving sales of approximately ₹1,985 crore. The 172-unit development underscores strong demand for integrated wellness and healthcare living.

headline: Orchasp Ltd AGM results: 7 resolutions passed
summary: Orchasp Limited held its 32nd AGM on September 30, 2026. All seven resolutions, including director appointments and preferential allotment, were passed with requisite majority.

headline: Raama Paper Mills AGM voting results
summary: Raama Paper Mills Limited submitted the scrutinizer's report for its AGM held on September 30, 2026. All four agenda items were approved unanimously by shareholders.

headline: Rachit Prints passes all AGM resolutions
summary: Rachit Prints Limited approved all six resolutions at its 23rd AGM, including financial statements adoption and director reappointments. Voting results showed unanimous support.

headline: Himalaya Nutravedics faces ₹2 Cr trademark suit
summary: Himalaya Global Holdings and Wellness Company filed a commercial suit against Himalaya Nutravedics India Ltd alleging trademark infringement and seeking damages of ₹2 crore.

headline: RITES gets ₹38.30 Cr tax relief for FY20
summary: RITES Limited secured a ₹38.30 crore relief from Gujarat State Tax authorities, overturning a demand order for FY20. The appeal against tax, interest, and penalty was allowed on September 30.

headline: Croissance Ltd AGM voting results submitted
summary: Croissance Limited submitted voting results for its 32nd AGM held on September 30, 2026. All four resolutions, including loan-to-equity conversion, passed with overwhelming support.

headline: Dhampur Sugar CFO certifies CP utilisation
summary: Dhampur Sugar Mills confirmed proceeds from Commercial Paper issued in Q2FY27 were used for disclosed purposes and subsequently repaid.

headline: Great Eastern Shipping names new Head of HR & Admin
summary: Salil Raghavan retires as Head (HR & Admin) of Great Eastern Shipping on October 4, 2026. Savitha Krishnamoorthy, General Manager HR, takes over effective October 5, 2026.

headline: Nykaa Q2FY27: GMV up 30%, Net Revenue up 29%
summary: Nykaa reports strong Q2FY27 growth with Consolidated GMV rising in early thirties and Net Revenue in late twenties. Fashion vertical drives scale with NSV up nearly 50%.

headline: Wardwizard Healthcare AGM results: All resolutions passed
summary: Wardwizard Healthcare Ltd shareholders unanimously approved all nine resolutions at the 42nd AGM, including auditor appointment and capital increase.
